create_listdataset: create a ListDataset from a list of text strings for PyTorch DataLoader iteration
create_matrixdataset: create a MatrixDataset from input_ids and attention_mask tensors for PyTorch DataLoader iteration
use_listdataset_getitem: use ListDataset getitem to retrieve a text string by index from the underlying list

review_listdataset_matrixdataset: review the ListDataset and MatrixDataset classes to understand their PyTorch Dataset interface implementations
